text:
zara (eng-platform): idea: add a compact "cost provenance" row on the dashboard card. shows: tokens, cache est., model sku, routing flag. lightweight, one-line.

ken (product): yes — customers repeatedly ask why similar routes cost different. short row + expand for details sounds right.

mei (eng-telemetry): we can emit an aggregated blob per-route per-tenant with fields: token_burn, tokens_saved_est, sample_rate, sku, routing_reason. will be derived if sample_rate < 100%.

omar (billing): make sure the blob is included in daily CSVs. auditors want a consistent key to reconcile. add derived_flag and correction_factor columns.

rui (design): UX: show a tiny badge for routing_reason (Q for quota, F for fallback). tooltip on hover explains. keep money off the one-liner unless user toggles billing mode.

zara (eng-platform): implementation plan: 1) telemetry: precompute daily aggregates via job that joins request_samples + prefetch_lineage. 2) API: /v1/costs/summary returns compact blob in the dashboard payload. 3) UI: inline one-liner + expand modal with CSV link.

mei (eng-telemetry): sample query draft below. will iterate but gives a starting point.

```
select tenant_id, route_id, sku, date_trunc('day', ts) as day,
  sum(token_count) as token_burn,
  sum(case when cache_hit then token_count end) * (1/sample_rate) as tokens_saved_est,
  avg(sample_rate) as sample_rate
from request_samples
where ts >= now() - interval '1 day'
group by tenant_id, route_id, sku, day;
```

omar (billing): for exports: include primary_tag, derived_flag, correction_factor. also include canary_percent if rollout active.

zara (eng-platform): perf note: UI should fetch the blob with the dashboard payload; no extra hover calls. also add 30s cache to reduce burst.

deploy-bot: job queued -> cost-provenance-precompute v0.1 -> staging. initiated by @zara.

ken (product): timeline?

zara (eng-platform): aiming staging in 1 sprint. I'll open API PR and RFC. if anyone wants to test accuracy early ping @mei for sample data. :pray:
